irregularities.text: Holdout favours continuation by construction: hidden catalogue segments cluster near visible ones, so F_CONT's HOLDOUT-DTI 0.1270 likely overstates live discovery performance on truly isolated undiscovered faults. A prior family continuation submission (h16-continuation) scored only 0.0461 live (user-prompt ledger). Promote is a holdout-evidence verdict, not a live-score promise.

Organizer problem page (fetched 2026-10-21) says outside-bounds data may be 'null or nan', yet the user was rejected with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. This raster uses finite zeros everywhere, satisfying the stricter platform reading; the rejected file itself was never available to diagnose.

Main previously carried two contradictory states (ASB candidate page said OK TO SUBMIT, index/README said DO NOT SUBMIT under a dense-continuous-prior reading of the registry rule). Resolved this session: lane checks are computed against binary scored registry rasters (winner, d28) and previously shipped binary rasters, which is the like-for-like reading of 'dots within 3px'; the dense continuous witness is not a submission raster. Selector should confirm this interpretation.
CI is a 2-draw range, not a spatial-block bootstrap; n=2 draws is low precision. Reported as ci95_draw_range everywhere, never as a bootstrap CI.

Budget: radiometric experiment's greedy/poisson E2 sweep and edge experiment reused the same holdout draws; 3 candidate hypotheses were tested (RAD, EDGE, CONT), then stopped, per the 3-experiment budget.
